verdict.rationale: Logseq offers a Plugin API and a local HTTP API server explicitly for external/third-party access to the graph (logseq-docs-5,6,13,21,22), which is the closest thing to an SDK for building integrations. However, the plugin API reference is explicitly 'community-driven' rather than official first-party documentation (logseq-docs-12), and probes show no machine-readable spec (no llms.txt, no OpenAPI/Swagger) making AI-native discovery/consumption harder (logseq-probe-1, logseq-probe-2). Community evidence also notes regressions in AI tool compatibility with the newer DB version ('Not being able to use Claude or codex anymore to write or update pages is a real deal breaker' — logseq-comm-11). missing for 10: first-party/official SDK documentation (vs community-maintained), machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI/llms.txt), confirmed working AI-agent integration in current version.
